modules.title: Contracts and source map
modules.input_output: Existing Monitor/report/job/guard owners -> typed, versioned records and a per-EA capability matrix.
modules.direct_consumer: All read adapters and typed request consumers.
acceptance: Every field maps to an exact source or explicit UNKNOWN; fixture/real/historical contexts remain distinct.
Schema compatibility preserves existing SafeProjection/index contracts; no risk or state authority added.
Producer/applicability/clock/missing-data behavior documented for each consumer.
negative_tests: Missing/malformed/stale/future/contradictory input; schema drift; unsafe strings; raw account/path leakage.
modules.authority_ceiling: No runtime/MT5 writes; shared contract writer only.
shared_denials: Git push, force/history rewrite, hook bypass

modules.title: Research Evidence Shelf
modules.input_output: Existing accepted report manifests and native graph bindings -> searchable run/evidence references.
modules.direct_consumer: Owner/CT inspecting backtest results and a future research request.
acceptance: Reuse Report V3; show setup and requested/effective delta before full parameters.
MAIN/BWD source/run/model/installation/config identities bind metrics and graph assets; comparisons refuse incompatible lineages.
Missing graph/package/samples remain visible; no MT5 rerun to beautify a report.
negative_tests: Wrong package; stale asynchronous selection; swapped MAIN/BWD; graph missing; hash mismatch; diagnostic Model2 performance refusal.
modules.authority_ceiling: Read-only accepted evidence; rejected/local artifacts cannot become accepted by import.
shared_denials: Git push, force/history rewrite, hook bypass

modules.title: NewsGuard and MacroGate read adapters
modules.input_output: Explicit qualified guard/MRIS files or projections -> observed guard health/state/age and evidence references.
modules.direct_consumer: Market Radar, portfolio detail and later historical research/features.
acceptance: Exact source schema/units/timestamps/modes mapped; raw state distinct from effective EA application.
No writes to MT5 GVs, NewsGuard/MacroGate runtime, publication feeds or Scheduled Tasks.
Missing NewsGuard GV/no veto and MacroGate stale fail-open behavior are reported, not silently changed.
negative_tests: Missing feed; late/out-of-order event; false fresh mtime; timezone/DST unknown; duplicate event; malformed number; disabled vs unavailable.
modules.authority_ceiling: Presentation freshness is not a new execution policy.
shared_denials: Git push, force/history rewrite, hook bypass

modules.title: Market Radar
modules.input_output: Qualified price/MRIS observations + guard observations -> symbol/TF market context.
acceptance: Reuse qualified existing regime logic first; prices, volatility, session and news shown with source time.
Multi-timeframe disagreement remains explicit; deterministic baseline before ML.
No global bullish label automatically activates EAs; unavailable inputs disable only dependent cards.
negative_tests: Unavailable symbol; incompatible broker clock; incomplete bars; stale prices; macro conflict; unsupported source field.
modules.authority_ceiling: No new paid feed, live collector activation or strategy rule.
shared_denials: Git push, force/history rewrite, hook bypass

modules.title: Portfolio and EA Health
modules.input_output: SafeProjection and qualified EA identity/telemetry -> account/cluster/EA/basket read views.
modules.direct_consumer: Owner risk-concentration inspection and recommendation/replay consumers.
acceptance: Bind device/installation/deployment/attach epoch/config to each observation; unknown coverage visible.
Normalize currency/cent/unit conventions explicitly; never aggregate cross-symbol raw lots as economic risk.
Show source-emitted ownership, basket/exposure and pending state; no guessed basket reconstruction.
negative_tests: Duplicate deployment; wrong attach epoch; account currency missing; stale sensor; unmapped EA; conflicting owner; incomparable returns.
modules.authority_ceiling: Read-only telemetry; inventory row or lane ownership does not prove running/attached/healthy.
shared_denials: Git push, force/history rewrite, hook bypass

modules.title: Existing Monitor shell integration
modules.input_output: Independently accepted module views/DTOs -> existing Monitor navigation and detail drawers.
modules.direct_consumer: Owner desktop/mobile application; no second frontend/SOT.
acceptance: Preserve five-view compatibility, existing Report V3 graph isolation and SafeProjection.
390x844 and 1280x900 browser checks; no horizontal page overflow; keyboard/touch and explicit empty/error states.
Feature OFF means no runtime behavior change; command capability is absent until a separately accepted gateway.
negative_tests: Malformed JSON; cache/offline/future state; ref mismatch; clipboard denial; path disclosure; missing feature; cross-record stale image.
modules.authority_ceiling: Only this integrator writes shared UI routing/cache/assets; modules arrive as completed inputs.
shared_denials: Git push, force/history rewrite, hook bypass

modules.title: Research Request and Job Console
modules.input_output: Exact approved experiment contract + frozen set/build/runner inputs -> validated request, existing Job ID/checkpoint/result.
modules.direct_consumer: Mainline researcher who wants non-chat submission/status without a new runner.
acceptance: Draft/preview binds EA, variant, Home, dates, tester model, installation, config hash, output scope and authority.
First contract uses fake runner; real launch requires qualified existing adapter and fresh lane reservation.
Idempotent request maps to one existing job; restart/resume reconciles accepted checkpoints; no model wait per cell.
negative_tests: Unapproved range; HOLDOUT request; closed contract; missing source; busy lane; duplicate click; incomplete job; expired authorization.
modules.authority_ceiling: No runtime commands or arbitrary shell; no dependency on Hermes V2-B; real MT5 phase separately contracted.
shared_denials: Git push, force/history rewrite, hook bypass

modules.title: Historical News/Macro Replay and Impact
modules.input_output: Qualified point-in-time event/vintage/clock data + source-bound trade/basket evidence -> attribution and separately qualified replay.
modules.direct_consumer: A named news/filter research hypothesis, not retrospective winner selection.
acceptance: Reuse canonical historical selectors and broker clocks; preserve release time, available_at, revision vintage and coverage gaps.
Descriptive overlap distinct from causal avoided-loss/missed-profit claims.
One approved paired replay/rerun holds all other mechanisms fixed; BWD/HOLDOUT not search inputs.
negative_tests: Future revision leakage; timezone ambiguity; overlapping baskets; missing bid/ask spread; post-hoc trade deletion; empty event coverage.
modules.authority_ceiling: No new experiment until exact consumer/acceptance exists; incomplete historical dataset stays blocked.
shared_denials: Git push, force/history rewrite, hook bypass

modules.title: Strategy Fit and Recommendation Sandbox
modules.input_output: Market context + explicit source-backed strategy profile + available portfolio constraints -> recommendation record.
modules.direct_consumer: Owner understands why a strategy is a match/mismatch; command draft consumer only.
acceptance: Separate market state, strategy fit, evidence strength and allocation/control.
Deterministic rule baseline; unknown/hostile constraints cannot be averaged away.
Accept stores a recommendation/intention only; no runtime transition.
negative_tests: Missing strategy profile; macro/technical conflict; unknown telemetry; missing sample semantics; fabricated grade; unqualified AI confidence.
modules.authority_ceiling: Runtime policy version is separate consequential work; no universal fit/risk thresholds.
shared_denials: Git push, force/history rewrite, hook bypass

modules.title: Typed Command and Authorization Gateway
modules.input_output: Authenticated typed research request or simulated bounded runtime intent -> validated authorized request/receipt.
modules.direct_consumer: CC06 first; an explicitly approved EA runtime adapter only later.
acceptance: Server-side target/action authorization; bind approval to exact content and expected state; no raw shell route.
Per-target IDs/sequences/TTL/idempotency/audit; retry and bulk partial application explicit.
Runtime handlers disabled and absent from R3; fake adapter proves ACK/REJECT/EXPIRED/UNKNOWN semantics.
negative_tests: Replay; tampering after approval; wrong account/device/epoch; auth bypass; CSRF; stale lease; reordered/duplicate command; partial ACK; prompt injection.
modules.authority_ceiling: Runtime-capable handlers require owner-approved semantics and qualified different-family review, even when written in Python.
shared_denials: Git push, force/history rewrite, hook bypass

modules.title: Feature Registry and Offline Model Lab
modules.input_output: Qualified frozen training data + feature/target contract -> reproducible model package and validation report.
modules.direct_consumer: One preregistered model/gate consumer; no generic AI research farm.
acceptance: Price-only pilot independent of macro replay; macro features require qualified CC07 data.
Chronological splits; train-only preprocessing; overlap/leakage controls; all model trials retained.
Model/feature/preprocessor/library/data hashes; schema/order/shapes/dtypes/opset and calibrated-output meaning explicit.
negative_tests: Leakage sentinel; reordered feature; scaler fitted on validation; data revision; invalid/NaN values; unknown label unit; exhausted compute budget.
modules.authority_ceiling: QI-2+ overlap must be resolved; no automatic training, paid API use, cloud credits or online model replacement.
shared_denials: Git push, force/history rewrite, hook bypass

modules.title: ONNX Adapter and Shadow Pilot
modules.input_output: Frozen model package and exact feature inputs -> Python/MQL parity and explicit shadow decision evidence.
modules.direct_consumer: Later one-gate child on a specifically eligible parent, not an automatically assigned B11-00.
acceptance: First actual contract can be fixture-only; any MQL/core integration requires qualified different-family review.
Python vs MQL full preprocessing/inference parity within preregistered tolerance and identical class semantics.
OFF parity and failure paths; no new lot/grid/exit/recovery behavior; gate scope explicitly new basket vs add/pending.
negative_tests: Missing/mismatched model; unsupported operator; shape/dtype/order mismatch; NaN; latency budget breach; ABSTAIN mistaken for FLATTEN; guard veto bypass.
modules.authority_ceiling: No actual core path reservation or change yet; shadow runtime installation also needs owner approval; no MT5 lane until contracted.
shared_denials: Git push, force/history rewrite, hook bypass

modules.title: Alerts, Decision Replay and Knowledge Links
modules.input_output: Accepted source events/receipts/report findings -> deduplicated owner alerts and evidence-linked timeline.
modules.direct_consumer: Owner diagnosis, incident review and an explicit Second Brain research consumer.
acceptance: What happened -> source evidence -> what was applied -> owner/next action; inference visibly separate.
Deduplicate correlated alert storms; stale historical rows never invent a current owner action.
Reuse existing knowledge/event owners; preserve negative results and avoid a second decision truth.
negative_tests: Duplicate alert; source missing; stale need-owner; invalid severity; unacknowledged command; LLM-generated unsupported cause; secret exposure.
modules.authority_ceiling: No notifier/scheduler activation or automatic retries that mutate runtime.
shared_denials: Git push, force/history rewrite, hook bypass

modules.title: Private Access, Backup/Restore and Operations
modules.input_output: Approved host/access topology + safe artifacts/config/audit -> tested operations/restore plan and later authorized private delivery.
modules.direct_consumer: Owner access outside chat and recovery after device/service failure.
acceptance: Design explicit service/host boundaries and loss-of-connectivity behavior; no BaBoss-first-online fallback.
Read-only access precedes commands; least privilege, authenticated encrypted access and secrets outside browser/repos.
Restore into fixtures proves hashes and state reconciliation; old command queues are not reissued.
negative_tests: Offline host; revoked credentials; wrong device; failed restore; stale browser cache; expiry after reconnect; stolen replayed receipt.
modules.authority_ceiling: No public URL, persistent service, tunnel restart, Scheduled Task or transport mutation under the design contract.
shared_denials: Git push, force/history rewrite, hook bypass

modules.title: Advanced Allocation, Protection and Recovery
modules.input_output: Separately ratified strategy/risk/ownership hypotheses -> future bounded research proposals only.
acceptance: Document trigger/action/unwind/ownership and exposure caps before any implementation.
Qualified different-family core review and mandatory compile/cages/experiments; no universal numeric defaults.
Portfolio control cannot silently reverse local safety/ownership; every mode has a separate activation gate.
negative_tests: Simultaneous recovery; overlapping basket owner; stale protection permission; exposure increase on uncertainty; recursive hedging; unsafe unwind.
modules.authority_ceiling: PARKED: no auto allocation, lot/grid adaptation, online learning, protection/recovery runtime or QI-2+ expansion.
shared_denials: Git push, force/history rewrite, hook bypass

Named direct consumer and downstream task saved
Explicit budget/stop rule; at most one bounded repair
Tests, negative cases and impacted regression
CT integration/state synchronization/eligible FF push only
Fresh owner approval at runtime/risk/deployment/strategy/QI-2+ hard stops
